# charge_reverse_map

`#!python charge_reverse_map()`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

Map each species' j/k-normalized identifier back to the `Specie`.

Built from `normalized_names` with the default `j`/`k` scheme.
The mapping avoids charge-marker/element-letter collisions but is not
injective in general: because `normalized_names` lower-cases,
case-distinct species (e.g. `CO` and `Co`) collapse onto the same
key.  Any such duplicate key raises `ValueError`.

**Returns**

_dict[str, Specie]_
: 

**Raises**

_ValueError_
: If two species normalize to the same identifier.
